mapper.sql: FROM product_sku s LEFT JOIN product_spu p ON p.id=s.spu_id AND p.deleted=FALSE LEFT JOIN product_category c ON c.id=p.category_id AND c.deleted=FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE s.deleted=FALSE AND s.id IN #{id}
SELECT WHERE s.deleted=FALSE AND p.id IS NOT NULL AND s.sku_code IN #{code}
